name: Optowide Technologies Co., Ltd.
blurb: Optowide Technologies (SSE: 688195), founded in 2003 and headquartered in Fuzhou, Fujian, produces precision optical components and passive fiber-optic components for optical communications, fiber lasers, quantum information research, biomedicine, and consumer optics. Its precision optics portfolio includes molded glass aspheric lenses — a technically demanding product where surface tolerances are measured in nanometres — optical filters, free-form lenses, plano optics, and spherical optics. Its fiber components division supplies telecom passive components and high-power laser components. The company is listed on the Shanghai STAR Market and appeared in Coherent Corp.'s 2022 10-K competitor list under Photonic Solutions. With a market capitalisation near 15 billion CNY and only five analyst firms providing coverage, it is among the more underfollowed names in the China photonics value chain.
recent: Optowide reported 2024 revenue of 445.14 million CNY, up 31% year-over-year, with net profit of 69.37 million CNY, up 67% — a meaningful acceleration in earnings leverage. As of early May 2026, shares carry a market cap near 15.2 billion CNY. The thin analyst coverage (two firms submitting estimates) reflects the company's small scale by index standards rather than any structural deficiency in the business.
